title: VeraLogics, Inc.: SAP Managed Services Team Lead
text: Headquarters: Argentina URL: https://veralogics.bamboohr.com/careers The SAP Managed Services Team Lead is responsible for leading a team of SAP support professionals to deliver high-quality, remote-based application support across multiple SAP modules. This role combines hands-on technical expertise with strong leadership and communication skills to ensure timely resolution of issues, continuous improvement of support processes, and optimal team performance. The Team Lead will serve as a key point of contact for clients, ensuring satisfaction and alignment with service-level agreements (SLAs). Key Responsibilities Team Leadership & Technical Oversight Lead and manage a team of SAP support analysts, providing guidance, mentorship, and performance feedback. Oversee day-to-day operations of SAP Managed Services, ensuring timely and effective resolution of incidents, service requests, and problem tickets. Act as an escalation point for complex SAP issues across modules such as FI/CO, MM, SD, HCM, and others. Monitor and report on team performance metrics, SLAs, and KPIs; identify areas for improvement and implement corrective actions. Stay current with SAP technologies, updates, and best practices to guide the team effectively. Customer Success Develop and nurture strong, long-lasting customer relationships. Understand client needs and objectives, ensuring alignment with project deliverables. Proactively identify opportunities for upselling or cross-selling additional services. Address and resolve customer concerns, seeking continuous improvement in customer satisfaction. Collaboration Facilitate effective communication between internal teams and clients. Coordinate resources and efforts across departments to achieve project milestones. Work closely with sales and account management teams to identify expansion opportunities. Documentation Maintain comprehensive project documentation, including project plans, timelines, and status reports. Create and update customer profiles, ensuring accurate and up-to-date records. Required Skills & Qualifications Proven experience leading SAP support or managed services teams. Strong understanding of SAP modules (at least two of: FI/CO, MM, SD, HCM, etc.). Hands-on experience with SAP troubleshooting, configuration, and support. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to manage client relationships. Familiarity with cloud platforms and SAP hosting environments. Experience with service management tools such as FreshService and ServiceNow. At least one SAP certification (e.g., SAP Certified Application Associate). Experience with ITIL processes and service delivery frameworks. Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. Preferred Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Business, or related field. Experience in remote team management and virtual collaboration tools. Knowledge of SAP S/4HANA and cloud migration strategies. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/veralogics-inc-sap-managed-services-team-lead

title: Lightbox Animation: Senior Sets&Props Model Artist
text: Headquarters: Córdoba, Andalusia, Spain URL: https://lbox.es Your mission Knock, knock...Any Lightboxer in the room? If you are passionate about 3D animated films and want to create magic cinematographic, you can´t let this opportunity go! We are looking for a talented ​ Senior Sets&Props Model Artist with enthusiasm to join our great team on the exciting new project, Animated Feature TAD 4!! ​You will be an essential part of our artistic team, responsible for creating environments and props models. First of all, you're probably interested in knowing that...we offer 100% remote work! WE NEED YOU TO BE ABLE TO DO: Apply your interpretation and artistic skill to translate concept art, environment designs into models to a fully 3D world. Ability to create or adapt models within different styles. Ability to understand proportions, spaces and volumes and transfer it to the 3D model. Good understanding of form along with textures and how it influences the final model. Deep knowledge making UVs under the direction of the supervisor and the surface department. Have a thorough knowledge of all aspects of the animation production process Strong artistic eye, who can successfully interpret a 2D design into a 3D model. Organizational skills to manage large environments and all their elements. Ability to find a balance between a quality model over time defined for it. Ability to develop the entire process of creating an environment, being able to solve the problems that appear both artistic and technical level. Look for solutions that optimize daily work when creating big sets. If needed, help and teach any of your colleagues with less experience. Excellent communication skills. Ability to work autonomously and independently in a fully remote environment, with that comes the supreme individual responsibility to prioritize and manage multiple tasks and maintain your own initiative. Great team player, create a collaborative and welcoming environment. Proven ability to meet deadlines and prioritize workload. Align with the style, sensibility of the project, Director vision, department and Supervisor demands. WE WILL MAKE THE PERFECT MATCH IF YOU HAVE: 5+ years of professional experience from either animation TV series or feature animation movie. Experience with Maya, SpeedTree and zBrush is a plus. Knowledge of organic, modular and procedural modeling. Knowledge of rendering engines and texturing programs is a plus. Experience with traditional drawing, sculpting is a plus. Ability to take feedback constructively and implement it effectively, to reach the quality desired. Anticipation and quick reaction for problem solving. Great attention to detail. Outstanding interpersonal and collaborative skills. Do you think we fit? Well, keep reading. WHAT WILL YOU FIND AT LIGHTBOX? We have a GREAT TEAM, taking animation to another level! Our pillars are: Strong passion : We are proactive with a positive working attitude, we continue to create successful films that conquer children and adults, so we need the motivation and energy of the best creative minds. Behind the scenes: Lightbox has an exciting mission: to bring incredible stories to life! We are happy and proud with giving the best possible value to the projects and continue achieving success. Be a Lightboxer : We need good teammates who are generally cool people and natural collaborators. Where everyone truly helps each other to grow. We love team and fun plans to disconnect and have a good time. ​ DURING THE TRIP WE CAN OFFER YOU: We are big fan of ensuring a "people first" company culture, with a good work-life balance for our employees. 100 % remote work. Nice working schedule from 8h to 16h, Monday to Friday, with some flexibility. 22 days working days annual holidays. Lightbox is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to building and promoting a diverse, equitable and inclusive workforce. Do you want to join us and help us continue creating magic cinematographic? About us If you are reading this it is because we have catched your attention!!! Yes, we are Lightbox Animation Studios; an animation studio focused on creating high-quality feature films, responsible for the successful Tadeo Jones saga. OUR MISSION: Bring incredible stories to life. Continue achieving success. PASSION: Obsessed with giving our best. We carry creativity in our DNA. TEAM SPIRIT: We are a great work team, which together achieve our objectives. You already know what we do and that we can offer you an incredible opportunity… Our team continues to grow and we are looking for the best creative minds. ...ANY LIGHTBOXER IN THE ROOM? We have great projects in our hands, one of them TAD 4 and we want you to be part of our next successes. What are we looking for? TO YOU! You are not afraid of challenges, you have strong motivation and energy, you like to contribute ideas and not simply execute, and you have creativity in your DNA. If you feel like you have the soul of a Lightboxer, we want to meet you! To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/lightbox-animation-senior-sets-props-model-artist

title: SimpleTiger: Web Developer: WordPress & HubSpot (U.S. Based, Remote Contractor)
text: Headquarters: Sarasota, FL URL: https://www.simpletiger.com/ SimpleTiger is hiring a part-time contract web developer to build, improve, and troubleshoot client websites in WordPress and HubSpot, with the potential to grow into a larger role. We’re a B2B SaaS marketing agency helping software companies grow through SEO, content marketing, paid media, and answer engine optimization (AEO). Our clients’ websites are where much of that work comes to life, and we’re looking for a developer who can turn ideas into clean, functional pages quickly. As part of our delivery team, you’ll work primarily on client websites, translating designs, campaign concepts, and SEO recommendations into effective web experiences. From building new pages to fixing issues on existing sites, you’ll help turn our marketing strategy into work that’s ready to launch. Key responsibilities Build, update, or troubleshoot client websites in WordPress and HubSpot CMS Make technical fixes and improvements to live client sites, with clear details on what was tested, implemented, and performance comparisons using tools like Screaming Frog, pagespeed insights, and Lighthouse Build and connect forms, lead routing, and simple automations between a site and the client’s marketing tools Set up and check tracking, like GA4, Google Tag Manager, and HubSpot tracking in Tandem with the SEO Manager Keep sites fast, accessible, and friendly to SEO (page speed, Core Web Vitals, clean markup, image optimizations, cache lifetime improvements, and so on) Write clear and timely notes on what you are actively working on, and any updates pushed live so our team and the client can follow along Qualifications and skills You’re a hands-on developer who can build from scratch, troubleshoot existing sites, and make improvements without disrupting what’s already working. Required skills WordPress development: Strong experience with custom themes, child themes, blocks, page builders, and Advanced Custom Fields (ACF). You can build a page from the ground up—not just edit an existing one. HubSpot CMS development: Strong experience with HubL templates, modules, and themes, including building and troubleshooting pages, forms, and email templates. Front-end development: Solid HTML, CSS, and JavaScript skills, with the ability to navigate existing code and understand how changes affect the live site. APIs and integrations: Experience working with the HubSpot or WordPress REST APIs, plus CRMs and marketing tools such as Salesforce, Zapier, n8n, Airtable, and Slack. Technical audits and fixes: Experience using Screaming Frog to audit WordPress and HubSpot sites, interpret findings, and resolve technical issues. Code review and cleanup: Comfort working within WordPress and HubSpot codebases to identify legacy or unused JavaScript and CSS, determine what’s still needed, and safely remove what isn’t. Async communication: Clear, timely written communication, especially through Slack. Independent work: Strong time management and the ability to meet deadlines, flag blockers early, and keep projects moving without close supervision. Nice-to-have skills Webflow development and auditing experience, including building a clean CMS structure. PHP development experience. Previous work at a marketing agency or with B2B SaaS clients. Familiarity with SEO and conversion best practices. Experience with Git and version control. What success looks like Success means delivering clean, reliable development work that helps our team turn marketing plans into live client experiences. Designs, campaign concepts, and SEO requests become functional pages in WordPress and HubSpot. Technical audit findings lead to practical fixes, with changes tested to avoid breaking existing functionality. Legacy and unused code is cleaned up thoughtfully, while essential code and front-end behavior remain intact. Forms, templates, and integrations work as intended and support the client’s marketing workflows. Projects stay on track because you manage your workload, meet agreed deadlines, and raise questions or blockers early. Teammates have clear visibility into progress through timely updates and straightforward communication in Slack. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/simpletiger-web-developer-wordpress-hubspot-u-s-based-remote-contractor

title: Notice: Frequent manual updates across platforms until v1.8.0 release
text: I am aware that frequent upstream updates to Electron and Chromium (often arriving every other day) currently require users across all platforms to manually re-download and reinstall Mise Browser to keep everything running smoothly. I recognise that having to constantly reinstall updates is frustrating and disrupts your workflow. I am actively working on a comprehensive packaging overhaul for the upcoming **v1.8.0** release to streamline this process. *** * **Current status:** Upstream system Electron updates or base runtime revisions can cause runtime and ABI mismatches immediately after system upgrades. * **Current workaround:** Until v1.8.0, you must pull and reinstall the latest Mise release / package whenever Electron or system dependencies update. * **Current status:** Security patches and rapid upstream Electron cycles require manually downloading and executing the latest installer or updating the portable binary folder. * **Current workaround:** Grab the newest setup executable from the Releases page when a new release is posted to ensure Chromium security patches are applied. * **Current status:** Due to frequent runtime bumps, users must manually replace the `.app` bundle in `/Applications` with each new release build. * **Current workaround:** Download the latest DMG / archive from GitHub Releases and overwrite your existing installation. *** The **v1.8.0** release focuses directly on resolving this update friction across all operating systems: * Streamlined distribution workflows. * Improved update mechanisms to eliminate repetitive manual re-installations. * Synchronised runtime packaging so you spend time browsing rather than maintaining your browser. Testing for v1.8.0 is currently underway across all environments to guarantee stability, security, and performance. I appreciate your patience while this testing is carried out. Please hold tight and bear with me for just a little longer whilst we polish and validate v1.8.0. Thank you for testing Mise and for your continued support!
